techStack: React 19, TypeScript 5.7.2 with noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters enforced — any removed prop left referenced causes a build error
Build: tsc -b && vite build — type-check runs before bundle, so TypeScript errors block the build
Test runner: Vitest 3 + @testing-library/react; all tests render <App /> (full integration, no component-level mocks)
Context pattern: React.createContext(null) + named Provider + custom hook (useFilterContext) that throws if used outside provider
useFilterContext() import path: '../context/FilterContext' (from components) or '../../context/FilterContext' (from pages)
features: FilterContext already exposes sortBy, setSortBy, category, setCategory — no changes needed to the context itself
useFilteredProducts already reads sortBy and category from FilterContext and applies them — it will auto-update once the wiring is fixed
SortSelect is props-driven (value: SortOption, onChange: (sortBy) => void) — requirement 4 says keep that interface, just pass context values from ProductListPage
ProductListPage has a localSortBy useState that shadows FilterContext.sortBy; SortSelect is wired to localSortBy, not context
ProductListPage passes onCategoryClick={() => {}} (no-op) to ProductList, which drills it to ProductCard
ProductCard currently calls onCategoryClick?.(category) on button click — needs to call useFilterContext().setCategory(category) instead
FilterPanel, pagination, search, in-stock toggle, clearFilters all work correctly and must not regress
architecture: Provider tree (App.tsx): ProductProvider > FilterProvider > FavouritesProvider > ComparisonProvider wraps all pages
ProductListPage (page layer): reads FilterContext + ProductContext; orchestrates filter UI; renders FilterPanel, SortSelect, ProductList
ProductList (presentational): maps products -> ProductCard; currently drills onCategoryClick prop
ProductCard (leaf): already uses ComparisonContext directly; needs to also use FilterContext directly for setCategory
New code belongs: useFilterContext() call added to ProductCard (same pattern as useComparisonContext already there)
SortSelect stays in page layer, controlled by props — ProductListPage passes context values down to it
edgeCases: Clicking a category already active: setCategory is still called; list stays correctly filtered (idempotent — no special handling needed)
SortSelect value must persist across unrelated re-renders (search input changes): guaranteed once wired to FilterContext.sortBy (context state is stable)
clearFilters test resets sortBy in FilterContext to 'default' — SortSelect must reflect this; works automatically once localSortBy is removed
Category button must remain in the DOM after prop removal (requirement 5 explicitly): button element stays, only the onClick handler changes
TypeScript noUnusedParameters: after removing onCategoryClick from ProductCard Props, any remaining reference (destructuring, usage) causes a build error — must be fully removed
TypeScript noUnusedLocals: after removing localSortBy useState, the setLocalSortBy setter must also be removed to avoid unused-variable error
